commitMessage: DEV-60: Build controlled execution lifecycle foundation
objective: Create a deterministic controlled execution lifecycle layer that connects completed execution states into a governed lifecycle record while preserving provenance, explainability, safety boundaries, and human authorization controls.
architecturalContext: DEV-54 controlled execution workflow orchestration foundation
DEV-55 controlled execution workflow runtime foundation
acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle layer consumes completed execution states.

Lifecycle output is deterministic and explainable.
Focused tests, River Dev typechecking, and main-project typechecking pass.
